description: Source code for ApplicationDispmanx class managing window creation, input, and display on Raspberry Pi 4 within the Cobalt project.

classes.name: ApplicationDispmanx
classes.description: Manages window creation, input, display, and event handling for Raspberry Pi within the Cobalt project.

methods.name: CreateWindow
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new window with given options.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes audio sink and other subsystems.

methods.name: Teardown
methods.description: Shuts down subsystems and cleans up.

methods.name: OnSuspend
methods.description: Handles suspension, hides video element, and resets input.

methods.name: OnResume
methods.description: Handles resumption, re-initializes input, and shows video element.

methods.name: AcceptFrame
methods.description: Updates video renderer with a new video frame.

methods.name: MayHaveSystemEvents
methods.description: Indicates if system events are available.

methods.name: WaitForSystemEventWithTimeout
methods.description: Waits for a system event with a specified timeout.

methods.name: WakeSystemEventWait
methods.description: Wakes any thread waiting for system events.
